content: {"episode_id":"ep-05015","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring), issued because precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before the service was rendered. The clinical indication note documents a patient presenting with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation, supported by diagnosis codes I48.91 and I48.0. Per that note, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is indicated for continuous rhythm assessment in order to accurately correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and optimize rate control management. We request reconsideration of the outstanding balance of 498.33 on episode ep-05015 based on this documented medical necessity."}
